strategies.name: Naive Sequential All-Reduce Loop
strategies.desc: Direct translation of reference code using 8 sequential all_reduce calls with intermediate coupling/decoupling operations. 8 all_reduce dispatches total. Represents the baseline with maximal dispatch overhead but simplest control flow and no optimization attempts.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Batched All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Pre-compute all coupling transformations locally, store intermediate buffers, then issue all 8 all_reduce operations back-to-back to allow XLA/compiler to potentially batch or pipeline them. Still 8 dispatches but reordered to enable backend fusion. Trades memory (7 extra buffers) for potential dispatch latency hiding.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (producing local shard only) followed by all_gather to reconstruct full vector. Each of 8 stages becomes 2 collectives (16 total dispatches) but reduce_scatter has W times smaller payload per rank. Exploits bandwidth-compute tradeoff when coupling operations dominate versus communication.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by separating intra-node and inter-node all_reduce phases. For each of 8 stages, perform node-local all_reduce (lower latency), then cross-node all_reduce on representative ranks, then broadcast back within nodes. Approximately 24 dispatches (8 stages × 3 collectives) but exploits faster intra-node links for bulk of data movement.

strategies.name: Pipelined Ring All-Reduce with Inline Coupling
strategies.desc:
Implement custom ring all-reduce using point-to-point send/recv primitives where coupling/decoupling operations are fused into the ring reduce-scatter and all-gather phases. Approximately 2×W×8 send/recv operations but eliminates separate coupling passes and exploits pipelining across the 224 shards to hide both computation and communication latency.
